temporal_model_validation.caption: All three locked model families and calibrators on the previously inspected evaluation day. Ranking and probability quality are separate diagnostics; calibration does not establish the simulator as the true user-response process. Bars have no uncertainty intervals.

feedback_retuning.caption: K=10, T=10,000. Negative differences favor UCB. Points and bars show paired mean differences and 95% Student-t intervals across 30 article pools. Retuning uses training pools only and is an exploratory follow-up to the frozen-setting reversal.

matched_feature_controls.caption: D=32 at matched layers, using separately train-selected exploration coefficients. Negative differences favor SAE features. Random controls average three direction seeds within each of the same 30 pools; bars are paired 95% Student-t intervals. Small dictionaries have 128 directions. Wide dictionaries select 128 training-variance coordinates from 16,384 directions. Article-level thresholded directions control activation frequency and are not token-level random SAEs. Full dimension and common-coefficient grids accompany this diagnostic.

feature_interventions.caption: Train-ranked top features versus equal-sized random masks. Left: local interventions in actual pre-action UCB states, with mean and uncertainty scores recomputed. Right: policies retrained from the first round without those coordinates. Random masks are averaged within pools; intervals use 30 independent pools. These are algorithmic feature interventions under the simulator, not causal claims about real users.

feature_necessity_across_simulators.caption: Retraining comparisons use the same primary training-derived ranks, top/bottom/random masks, exploration coefficients, and article/user pools under both response simulators. Positive differences indicate greater regret after top-ranked removal than after equal-sized random removal. Five random masks are averaged within each pool; intervals use 30 paired pools. The two simulator fits are sensitivity conditions, not independent replications or real-user causal evidence.

automated_semantic_controls.caption: One blinded Gemma 12B captioner describes all first 32 coordinates from earlier-day examples. Wide controls select training-variance coordinates from 16,384 directions; a prespecified direction seed (11) is used for semantic comparisons. BGE scores caption agreement on strictly unseen news with category-matched negatives. Bars average all 32 coordinates, assigning chance to captioner abstention or insufficient held-out support; annotations indicate incomplete coverage when present. Scores conditional on adequate support are also retained. This automated proxy is not human semantic validation. Coordinates within a layer are dependent, so no independent-feature confidence bars are shown. Small-dictionary semantic controls are also retained in the complete results.

tool_only_baselines.caption: Historical LLM decisions and direct policies on identical fixed environments, K=5/10 and T=500. Negative differences favor the listed policy. Intervals are paired 95% Student-t intervals across 30 pools. These historical LLM runs precede the new matched ablation harness and remain explicitly labeled.

matched_agent_baselines.caption: Fresh matched Gemma and Qwen agents on the same frozen legacy response bank, 30 pools and 500 rounds. Negative differences favor the listed agent/policy over direct posterior-mean choice. Bars are pointwise paired 95% Student-t intervals; the complete eight-baseline comparison family and Holm-adjusted p-values are retained in the tables. Headline-only prior probes are separate from online decisions. These simulations do not establish real-user effects.

matched_agent_ablations.caption: Every Gemma ablation at K=5 and K=10, paired to its corresponding original tool or no-tool condition. Negative differences favor the ablation. Always-displayed statistics are compared with the original optional-tool agent. Bars are pointwise paired 95% Student-t intervals across 30 pools; all 18 contrasts and their family-wise Holm-adjusted p-values are retained. Generation uses one fixed seed per condition, so intervals do not estimate repeated-generation variability.
